description: NaZr₂N₂SCl crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to three equivalent S and three equivalent Cl atoms to form edge-sharing NaS₃Cl₃ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-2.87 Å. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.74-2.82 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four N, two equivalent S, and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Zr-N bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.20 Å. There is one shorter (2.72 Å) and one longer (2.77 Å) Zr-S bond length. The Zr-Cl bond length is 2.97 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four N, one S, and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of Zr-N bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.18 Å. The Zr-S bond length is 2.73 Å. There is one shorter (2.91 Å) and one longer (3.01 Å) Zr-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to four Zr atoms to form NZr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with six NZr₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three NZr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-50°. In the second N site, N is bonded to four Zr atoms to form NZr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with six NZr₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three NZr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-49°. S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three Zr atoms to form SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with six NZr₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, edges with six equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three NZr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. Cl is bonded to three equivalent Na and three Zr atoms to form distorted ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, corners with six NZr₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent ClNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, edges with six equivalent SNa₃Zr₃ octahedra, and edges with three NZr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°.
